registryAssessment: Xingtai government-news coverage of a municipal government press conference quotes the Xingtai Real Estate Registration Center director and deputy directors describing the center’s city registration workflows (first, transfer, mortgage, cancellation; city service-window channels). Xingtai’s government information portal lists the municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau. This establishes local registry activity, but not open parcel geometry.

The transcript records the municipal Real Estate Registration Center director describing first registration, transfer, mortgage and cancellation workflows, window services, and the Hebei integrated application system. Online filing and personal registration information require an applicant workflow. The government pages reviewed did not disclose a public parcel feature service, schema or geometry-only query. No application was initiated.
